name: compact-handoff
description: Shows task progress above the prompt and leaves a note so work carries on after the conversation is compacted (/work, /handoff)

band.title: Task progress line
band.description: When there is a task list, shows one line above the prompt: '▶ 2/5 current task'. When off, /work still opens the summary.

handoff.title: Handoff note at compaction
handoff.description: When a long conversation is compacted automatically, leaves a note of requests, tasks and edited files so the work is not lost.
